headline: PLAVE to hold world tour encore at Gocheok Sky Dome in January
sub: Three-day 'KEEP IT MANIC' encore concerts in Seoul
source: Source: Yonhap News, Topstarnews, Sports Kyunghyang
caption:
Virtual idol group PLAVE will hold their world tour encore concerts at Seoul's Gocheok Sky Dome in January.

'2026 PLAVE World Tour [KEEP IT MANIC] Encore' runs for three days, Jan 22–24. The fan club presale opens Dec 1 at 8 PM KST, and general sales open Dec 4 at 8 PM KST on NOL Ticket.

📌 Source: Yonhap News (via Korean media), Topstarnews, Sports Kyunghyang
